narrative: 廉价、广角，或老式的镜片无法把所有颜色都聚焦在同一个平面上。一根树枝、一个肩膀、一块霓虹招牌，长出了一圈红色或青色的“胡须”。
这个光学系统是刻意不完美的，或者它只是单纯老旧了。用在玻璃应该“坦白”自己缺陷的时候：低保真的夜晚，一场光学意义上而非调色意义上的梦境，一次全开光圈的广角拍摄。
让这些色边依附在高对比度的边缘上，并在画面角落更强烈。用在整幅画面的RGB通道整体错位上，这个手法就用错了，那属于通道偏移，而不是像差。
如果整幅画面就是同一张图的三层叠加，你拍到的是一种数字处理手段，而不是色差（Chromatic Aberration）。
how: 使用广角镜头、全开光圈，以及简单或老式的镜片设计。横向色差会随着离画面中心的距离而增强。
纵向色差表现为彩色的焦外散景（前方洋红，后方绿色，或者相反）。通过让高对比度边缘产生“色边”来重现它，而不是把整个色彩通道整体挪动。
提示词：red-cyan fringing at high-contrast edges, stronger at the frame edge, cheap or vintage glass.
when: 一座夜晚的天桥，一件雨衣衬着霓虹灯，最亮的招牌边缘和剪影上出现红青色的色边。不要把整个人物做成RGB通道分离，当成一种通道偏移效果。
vs: 镜头光晕（Lens Flare）是散射和鬼影，不是边缘色边。鱼眼镜头（Fisheye）是极端的桶形畸变。
它可以带有色差，但那是一种几何形态，而不是一种色彩错误。老式电影镜头（Vintage Cine Glass）常常同时包含色差、雾化和暗角。
镜头畸变是空间上的扭曲。色差则是叠加在这些扭曲之上、或独立于这些扭曲之外的一种色彩聚焦错误。
examples_film: 《春假纵队》（Spring Breakers）让带有廉价质感的色边和模拟信号误差停留在派对灯光上。音乐录影带常常把横向色差作为一种全开光圈的夜间风格来推崇。
《入侵脑细胞》（Enter the Void）把光学误差用作主观化的夜晚，这是一种语法，而不是一套模板。
mistakes: 错误的近亲：RGB通道分离、镜头光晕，或鱼眼式的拉伸。破绽是：整个主体变成了三份彩色的副本，或者只有一道没有边缘色边的彩虹光条。
解决办法是：把色彩限制在高对比度边缘，让它在偏离中心时增强，并保持核心图像的对位精准。

faq.a: 色差是不同波长的光无法共享同一个焦点或同一个放大倍率而产生的色边。横向色差在边缘处长出“胡须”。纵向色差则给焦点前后的虚化部分染上颜色。

faq.q: 色差 vs 镜头光晕
faq.a: 光晕是杂散光造成的鬼影和雾化。色差是一种聚焦误差，会在对比边缘上呈现出不同的颜色。一个是散射，另一个是色散。
当这个光学系统应该显得不完美时使用：老式镜片、广角夜景，一幅略显不可信的画面。不要使用整幅画面的通道分离。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写色差的提示词？
faq.a: 要求在高对比度边缘出现红青色（或指定颜色）的色边，在画面角落更强烈，来自廉价或老式镜片。禁止整幅画面的RGB偏移。

narrative: Cheap, wide, or vintage glass fails to put all colors on the same plane. A branch, a shoulder, a neon sign grows a red or cyan beard.
The optic is imperfect on purpose, or it is simply old. Use it when the glass should confess: lo-fi night, a dream that is optical rather than a grade, a wide at full aperture.
Tie fringes to contrast edges, stronger in the corners. It is the wrong tool as a full-frame RGB split, which is a channel offset, not aberration.
If the whole image is three layers of the same picture, you have a digital treatment, not CA.
how: Wide angle, wide open, simple or vintage designs. Lateral CA scales with distance from center.
Longitudinal CA shows as color bokeh (magenta in front, green behind, or the reverse). Recreate by fringing high-contrast edges, not by sliding entire channels.
Prompt: red-cyan fringing at high-contrast edges, stronger at the frame edge, cheap or vintage glass.
when: A night overpass, raincoat against neon, red-cyan fringes on the brightest sign edges and the silhouette. Do not RGB-split the entire figure as if it were a channel offset.
vs: Lens Flare is scatter and ghosts, not edge fringes. Fisheye is extreme barrel distortion.
It can carry CA but is a geometry, not a color error. Vintage Cine Glass often includes CA plus haze and vignette.
Distortions are spatial warps. CA is a color-focus error on top of, or instead of, those warps.
examples_film: Spring Breakers lets cheap-looking fringing and analog error sit on party lights. Music videos often push lateral CA as a wide-open night look.
Enter the Void uses optical error as subjective night, which is grammar, not a template.
mistakes: Wrong cousin: RGB split, lens flare, or fisheye stretch. Tell: the whole subject is three colored copies, or only a rainbow streak with no edge fringe.
Fix: confine color to high-contrast edges, increase it off center, keep the core image registered.

faq.q: What is chromatic aberration in film?
faq.a: Color fringing from wavelengths that do not share a focus or a magnification. Lateral CA beards edges. Longitudinal CA colors the blur in front of and behind the mark.
Flare is stray light making ghosts and veils. Chromatic aberration is a focusing error that puts different colors on contrast edges. One is scatter. The other is dispersion.

faq.q: When should I use chromatic aberration?
faq.a: When the optic should look imperfect: vintage glass, wide night work, a slightly untrustworthy image. Do not use a full-frame channel split.

faq.q: How do I prompt chromatic aberration for AI image or video?
faq.a: Ask for red-cyan (or named) fringing on high-contrast edges, stronger at the corners, from cheap or vintage glass. Ban whole-image RGB offsets.
